test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter, number, symbol series and answer the question.

(Left)S 3 F X # 7 M T & 8 R 9 Y Z * 2 C G 6 A (Right)

If all numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be sixth from the right?
solution:
Given series:

S 3 F X # 7 M T & 8 R 9 Y Z * 2 C G 6 A

Condition to be checked:

If all numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be sixth from the right?

Series after dropping numbers:

S F X # M T & R Y Z * C G A

Counting from the right:

 
• A
 
• G
 
• C
 
• *
 
• Z
 
• Y

Thus, the sixth element from the right is **Y**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
